step.title: Tea together
step.prompt: Bonjour Fatima ! J'ai apporté un peu de musique d'Égypte et de Fès. On écoute ensemble ?
step.promptTranslation: Hello Fatima! I brought some music from Egypt and Fès. Shall we listen together?
step.caregiverTip: Greet her in Darija if you can ("Salam, labas?"). Let her settle before starting.

step.title: Oum Kalthoum, 'Enta Omri' (1964)

entity.name: Oum Kalthoum
entity.description: The Star of the East, Egyptian singer; 'Enta Omri' (1964).

step.prompt: Écoutons Oum Kalthoum. Quelle voix ! Qu'est-ce que cette chanson vous évoque ?
step.promptTranslation: Let's listen to Oum Kalthoum. What a voice! What does this song bring to mind?
followUps: Fermez les yeux et laissez-vous porter, si vous voulez.
step.caregiverTip: Her songs are long: play just the opening few minutes, softly.

step.title: Faten Hamama on screen

entity.name: Faten Hamama
entity.description: The lady of the Arab screen.

step.prompt: Regardez cette photo de Faten Hamama. Qu'est-ce que vous remarquez ?
step.promptTranslation: Look at this photo of Faten Hamama. What do you notice?
followUps: Si vous voulez, racontez-moi le cinéma à Fès.
step.caregiverTip: A black-and-white still works best. Let her talk about the cinema of the medina if she wishes.
step.mediaHint: Search 'Faten Hamama 1960s black and white photo'

step.title: Mint tea, the morning ritual
step.prompt: Sentez cette menthe fraîche. Vous me montrez comment vous préparez le thé ?
step.promptTranslation: Smell this fresh mint. Will you show me how you make the tea?
followUps: Vous me montrez votre façon de servir le thé ?
step.caregiverTip: Fresh mint to smell is enough. Check any swallowing or diet guidance before offering tea.

step.title: Sway along: Abdelhalim Hafez

entity.name: Abdelhalim Hafez
entity.description: Egyptian singer and actor, 'the dark nightingale'.

step.prompt: Abdelhalim Hafez ! On se balance doucement avec la musique ?
step.promptTranslation: Abdelhalim Hafez! Shall we sway gently with the music?
step.caregiverTip: Gentle hand movements from the chair are plenty.

step.title: Warda Al-Jazairia

entity.name: Warda Al-Jazairia
entity.description: Algerian-Egyptian singer, star from the 1960s.

step.prompt: Une dernière chanson, toute douce : Warda. On l'écoute ?
step.promptTranslation: One last gentle song: Warda. Shall we listen?
step.caregiverTip: People who enjoy Oum Kalthoum and Abdelhalim Hafez also tend to enjoy Warda. A smile is the answer.

step.title: Thank you, Fatima
step.prompt: Merci Fatima, c'était un très beau moment avec vous.
step.promptTranslation: Thank you Fatima, that was a lovely moment with you.
step.caregiverTip: End warmly. Note which songs made her smile.
